races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Three-time C&D winner UNA MATATA is very well treated on her form here earlier in the year and having produced her best effort for some time when third over C&D 12 days ago, she could well be ready to strike. Leannespour remains pretty lightly raced and isn't one to be writing off from her basement mark, whilst Expound finds himself operating from a career-low mark if bouncing back over this shorter trip. Roman Harry completes the shortlist.

  1. UNA MATATA (IRE)
  2. LEANNESPOUR (IRE)
  3. EXPOUND
